upstream-localize.adaptation_notes: Specific SAM3 prompts, ambiguity handling and observed geometry. Visible surfaces can bias centers; validate with both cameras. Never copy fixed pixels or thresholds as target truth.

upstream-grasp.adaptation_notes: Candidate selection and grasp verification patterns. Use SO-101 defaults, TCP +X approach, measured angular jaw and five-axis reachability. Contact-GraspNet/Panda TCP assumptions and free-object lift success are not this benchmark contract.

upstream-mobile-grasp.adaptation_notes: Alternative grasp candidates and geometry-based feasibility. R1 Pro TCP +Z, parallel jaw span, mobile base and torso do not apply. Do not remove the entire target from obstacles; SO-101 permits only distal pad contact. A 5mm lift is not retention verification.

upstream-transport.adaptation_notes: Retain grip during transit, observe slip and avoid home opening the gripper. Solver-conditioning tricks and absolute transport heights are robot/task specific. Derive feasible paths from observations.

upstream-manipulation.adaptation_notes: Contact, rotation and pull ideas; some entries are templates without validated code. SO-101 has five axes; knob/hinge mechanics are not strawberry mechanics. Current synthetic release models bend/pull and straight pull, not calibrated axial-torsion fracture.
